title: fix(plugin-calendar,i18n): route every CalendarView accessible name through the locale packs
body:
Fixes #10104

Clause-②: no — routing user-visible strings through the existing i18n channel and adding keys.

## The sweep criterion, and the count it produced

The card named six `aria-label` literals and said the count was a reading on one tree at one moment, not a budget. This branch re-swept and wrote its criterion down first.

**A string is IN SCOPE when all three hold:**

1. **It reaches a user** — as the value of an attribute a screen reader speaks or a browser shows (`aria-label`, `aria-description`, `aria-roledescription`, `aria-placeholder`, `aria-valuetext`, `title`, `alt`, `placeholder`), or as a JSX text node.
2. **It is authored in this file as English prose** — a whole literal, or an English fragment embedded in a template expression.
3. **No pack can reach it** — it is not already an argument to `t()`.

**Deliberately OUT, each for a stated reason:**

- `className`, `style`, `role`, `key`, `id`, `tabIndex`, `data-` attributes — neither spoken nor shown.
- The view select's option values (`day` / `week` / `month`) — machine values of the view enum; the text shown beside them is already a `t()` child.
- Runtime data echoed into a label — the event title, the day number. That is the author's or the user's own text, and a pack must not translate it.
- `Intl` output — `toLocaleDateString` / `toLocaleTimeString`. Localized by a locale argument, not by a pack.
- Comments and test ids.

**The count that criterion produced: ELEVEN sites, in three shapes.**

| shape | count | what |
|---|--:|---|
| whole-literal `aria-label` | 8 | both landmarks, the three toolbar buttons, three resize grips |
| whole-literal `title` | 1 | the month grip's tooltip |
| English frame wrapped around localized data | 2 | the current-date button, and the day gridcell's inline event count |

Two of the eight (`Resize start` / `Resize end`, in `TimeGridView`) are beyond the card's six. The `title` and the two frames fall in the three categories the card explicitly left unmeasured.

## The reading the card declined to make

The card refused to report that no `aria-label` here is routed, because its probe's zero had no lit control. Established here with one, same probe, same command:

- repo-wide over `packages/` and `apps/`: **192** routed-attribute hits.
- scoped to `packages/plugin-calendar/`: **zero**.

So the zero is a reading. No `aria-label` in this package was routed — while `CalendarView.tsx` already imported `createSafeTranslation` and already routed its *visible* copy through that same `t`. The channel was there; the accessible names never used it.

## The repair

Every one of the eleven now resolves through `useCalendarTranslation`, the `createSafeTranslation` hook this file already used — the same mechanism `ObjectCalendar.tsx` uses, read but not edited (it belongs to objectui#10101).

Keys land in **all ten packs** under `calendar.a11y`, because the key-set invariant is pack-versus-pack: an English call-site fallback carries the call site and never the key set. Values translate the MEANING — `Calendar` and `Calendar grid` are spoken landmark names, so each pack gets a name that works as one in that language, not a word-for-word transcription.

The gridcell's count is a **plural family with a base key**. `ru` has four plural categories and `ar` six; only `_one` and `_other` are spelled out, so both bases are written in a count-first form that is grammatical at any number, and the categories a pack does not enumerate resolve in its own language rather than falling through to English (objectui#3863's rule).

## The pin

`CalendarView.a11yLabelsLocalized-10104.test.tsx` mounts under **zh** and asserts no swept label equals its English literal. An en-locale assertion on English text would pass identically on both trees, so it is not used as the pin.

Two lit controls, both asserted rather than assumed:

- **locale probe** — `calendar.today` was routed before this card, so it renders zh on the defect tree too. It passing is what makes an English `aria-label` beside it the component's doing rather than a provider that never switched language.
- **pack divergence** — every asserted key is checked live to be a non-empty string in `en` and to differ between `en` and `zh`, so a lost key or two agreeing packs cannot make the assertions vacuous.

## Evidence

**RED-before / GREEN-after**, file state verified in the same command as each run:

- RED on the unfixed tree (`CalendarView.tsx` and `en.ts` on-disk hashes asserted equal to their HEAD blobs): `Tests 5 failed | 2 passed (7)`, naming `en lacks 9 swept key(s)`.
- GREEN after: `Tests 7 passed (7)`.

**Ablation** — the discriminating one: revert ONLY the component, leave all ten packs carrying the new keys.

- mutation proven by object hash (on-disk hash equals the base blob, differs from the fixed blob); on-disk counts corroborate: routed spellings `0`, English literal `aria-label`s `8`.
- pin goes RED with the real symptom: `7 English literal(s) still reach the DOM under zh: ['Calendar', 'Calendar grid', ...]`, while the pack control stays green — so the pin observes the COMPONENT, not the packs.
- restore proven by object hash equal to the fixed blob AND by an empty `git diff HEAD`, never by an exit code.

**Which i18n gates actually SELECT these files** — probed, not assumed:

- `check:i18n-keys` — **selects, proven**. Mutating one new `en` value made it name `packages/plugin-calendar/src/CalendarView.tsx` and the key `calendar.a11y.region` as `factory-default-drift`; mutation and restore both proven by hash. Green on the merged tree.
- `check:i18n-drift` — **selects**, and says so itself: `13 key(s) added, 0 removed`, exactly this branch's 13 keys. Its judgement is about changed values, so additions are correctly not its business. Green.
- `all-locales-key-parity.test.ts` — **selects**; confirmed present in the collected set, not inferred from a passing summary.
- `check:i18n-dead-keys` — selects; none of the new keys is reported dead. Report-only, not wired to CI.
- `check:i18n-designer-parity` — **does NOT select these files**: it reads the metadata-admin designer table only. Its green is not counted here.
- `check:eager-locale-catalogues` — **NOT MEASURED locally**. It refused to run: `PREREQUISITE NOT MET`, it needs a built console bundle, and it prints that this is not a pass. It weighs which catalogues sit in the eager closure — composition, not key counts — and this diff does not touch the import graph. Its source-shape sibling `entry-locale-shape-7479.test.ts` ran green in the package suite; CI's performance-budget workflow owns the built-bundle leg.

**Suites and typecheck**, on the merged tree (`08d4d7234`): `Test Files 108 passed (108)`, `Tests 1435 passed (1435)` over `packages/i18n/` and `packages/plugin-calendar/`; both packages' `type-check` green, each running `tsconfig.test.json` too, so the new pin is typechecked. Green also: `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:changeset-no-major`.

**Changeset** — decided by running the gate, not from memory: it reported two released packages with no changeset and exited 1. A real `patch` was added for both; the gate now exits 0.

**Base**: objectui#10091 landed on these same ten packs while this branch was in flight, so `origin/main` was merged in and every gate above was re-run on the merged tree. objectui#10101 is still open and was not merged; `ObjectCalendar.tsx` is its file and is untouched here.

## Acceptance notes

Noted while sweeping, deliberately NOT repaired here and NOT filed:

- The month gridcell formats its date with a hard-coded runtime-default locale while the sibling time-grid column uses the component's own `locale` prop, so an author who passes a locale gets it honoured in one view and ignored in the other. Out of this card's scope — it is `Intl` argument routing, not a string a pack can reach — and it is the same `locale` versus `effectiveLocale` split that several other call sites in this file share. Carrier: whoever routes this file's date formatting through `effectiveLocale`.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:日历组件里十一处只有英文、语言包够不到的用户可见文案(其中两处是两个地标唯一的名字),现在全部走已有的 i18n 通道,十个语言包各补十三个键。
- **为什么改**:中文控制台下,视力正常的用户看到的是中文日历,而读屏用户听到的是英文「Calendar」「Calendar grid」。
- **风险与代价**:只增键、不改既有值,漂移门禁自证「0 个 en 值变更」;回滚即 revert 本 PR,无数据迁移。
- **席位意见**:(待填)
- **你要做的**:确认十种语言的译法是否符合产品口径,尤其是两个地标名与 ru/ar 的复数基键写法。
